description: This file serves as the entry point for setting up an Express.js server application. It imports necessary middleware, route handlers, and Swagger documentation, configures middleware such as CORS and JSON parsing, sets up health check and API documentation endpoints, registers routes for authentication, user management, plans, and execution, and applies a global error handler.

methods.name: createApp()
methods.description: Creates and configures an Express application with routes, middlewares, CORS, Swagger documentation, and error handling.
